code:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm install --production
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
caption: Base image, working directory, dependencies first, then the rest of the code, then the start command.
